Author: Rahul Chaturvedi

?Court No. - 67

Applicant :- Kamalkant

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Yadav,Abhilasha Singh,Shyam Lal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rahul Chaturvedi,J.
Heard Sri Ashutosh Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

By means of the present application, the prayer sought by the applicant is to quash the charge sheet dated 18.04.2022 under Section 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.Act arising out of case crime no. 1028 of 2021, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Etah as well as entire proceeding of S.T. No. 338 of 2022.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has already been bailed out and charges have not been framed as yet.

If so advised, the applicant may apply for discharge within next one week and therefore the court concerned shall decide the discharge application within four weeks of the institution of the discharge application by well reasoned order after hearing both the parties.
